items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: And I will never forget it, because I played with him until the porter swept us out.

ctx.x: a downstairs club . State and Lake , just a little north, on the East Side. Where the Three Deuces was across the street on the West Side.

So I was listening and mostly all musician. And they got Bix to sit in. And Bix called some tune Either Tut didnt know the tune, for some reason, didn't go so good, Whatever it was, Wingie just got up again and walked over to me and grabbed me like everything's forgotten, sat me up there to play with them. And I will never forget it, because I played with him until the porter swept us out.
